import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate the CSV data by month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
pivot = df.pivot_table(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0).sort_index()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.stackplot(pivot.index, [pivot[region].values for region in pivot.columns], labels=pivot.columns)
ax.set_title('Revenue by Month and Region')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
